invalid_run_limits.fix: This indicates a bug: configuration validation should already reject a bad `timeout_seconds`. Open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
invalid_run_limits.summary: The process runner got a timeout or output limit that is not a positive number, so it refused to start the command.

invalid_snapshot_directory.fix: Point `TMPDIR`, `TEMP` or `TMP` at a local directory whose full path has no commas, then rerun `finassist check`. If the path has no comma, this indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code.
invalid_snapshot_directory.summary: The exported source snapshot is not a directory or its path contains a comma, which would break the container mount argument.

local_execution_not_approved.fix: Prefer `--backend docker` or `--backend podman` with a digest-pinned `runner_image`. Add `--approve-local` only for trusted code; a local workflow needs it on `workflow run` and on every `workflow resume`.
local_execution_not_approved.summary: Local recipe execution was requested without `--approve-local`; local mode runs code with no OS filesystem or network isolation.

non_reaping_wait_required.fix: Run recipes on Linux, macOS or native Windows Python, which provide a supported process-exit API. Container backends are affected too, because the container CLI runs under the same supervision.
non_reaping_wait_required.summary: This platform has neither waitid with WNOWAIT nor kqueue, so the runner can't safely supervise and clean up recipe processes.

recipe_not_configured.fix: Use a name listed under `recipes`, or add the recipe as an array of literal arguments to your reviewed configuration and pass it with `--config`. Without `--config`, the built-in defaults define no recipes.
recipe_not_configured.summary: The requested recipe name is not defined in the configuration's `recipes`, so there is no approved command to run.

unsupported_runner.fix: Use `--backend docker`, `--backend podman` or `--backend local`. The CLI already restricts this choice, so seeing this code from the CLI indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
unsupported_runner.summary: The requested runner backend is not docker, podman or local, so there is no supported way to execute the recipe.

windows_initial_thread_invalid.fix: Retry once. Tools that inject threads into new processes, such as some security or debugging software, may cause this. If it repeats, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code.
windows_initial_thread_invalid.summary: The suspended recipe process on Windows did not have exactly one initial thread, so it was stopped instead of resumed.

windows_job_attachment_failed.fix: Run from a normal user session; some sandboxes, CI agents or launchers apply Job Object limits that block this. If it persists, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code.
windows_job_attachment_failed.summary: Windows refused to place the recipe process in the tool's kill-on-close Job Object, so the process was not resumed.

windows_job_cleanup_failed.fix: Check Task Manager for leftover recipe processes and end them if present. This indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
windows_job_cleanup_failed.summary: Closing the Windows Job Object that supervises the recipe failed, so cleanup of its processes could not be confirmed.

windows_job_unavailable.fix: Retry from a normal user session; restricted sandboxes or low system resources can block Job Objects. If it persists, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code.
windows_job_unavailable.summary: Windows could not create or configure the kill-on-close Job Object used to supervise recipes, so nothing was started.

windows_thread_open_failed.fix: Retry from a normal user session. Security software that restricts thread access may cause this. If it repeats, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code.
windows_thread_open_failed.summary: Windows denied access to the suspended recipe process's initial thread, so it could not be resumed and was stopped.

windows_thread_resume_failed.fix: Retry once; another tool that suspends or resumes threads, such as a debugger, may cause this. If it repeats, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code.
windows_thread_resume_failed.summary: Resuming the suspended recipe process's thread failed or reported an unexpected suspend count, so the process was stopped.

windows_thread_snapshot_failed.fix: Retry once; low system resources may cause this. If it repeats, run the check in WSL or Linux and open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
windows_thread_snapshot_failed.summary: Windows could not take the thread snapshot needed to find and resume the suspended recipe process, so it was stopped.

workflow_artifact_approval_required.fix: Run `finassist workflow status --run-id` and inspect the attempt's saved file, then pass its exact `recovery_artifact_hash` to `--approve-artifact`. If the hash changed since you inspected it, review the file again.
workflow_artifact_approval_required.summary: The `--approve-artifact` hash does not match the saved result for this attempt, so the result was not adopted.

workflow_artifact_missing_or_changed.fix: Don't edit or recreate files in the state directory to clear this. Restore the original `workflow-runs` files from a backup if you have one and recheck `workflow status --run-id`; otherwise treat that evidence as lost.
workflow_artifact_missing_or_changed.summary: A retained run file or attempt result is missing, too large, or no longer matches the hashes in the audit ledger.

workflow_bundle_invalid.fix: Use exactly `schema_version` 1, `name`, `profile`, `packs` (1-16 unique `path`/`sha256` entries) and `recipe_bindings`, with no extra fields. Start from the documented starter bundle.
workflow_bundle_invalid.summary: The workflow bundle is not valid UTF-8 JSON or does not match the bundle schema, so its packs can't be resolved.

workflow_bundle_too_large.fix: Check that `--bundle` points to the bundle file, not a pack or other document. A valid bundle holds only pack pins and `recipe_bindings` and is far smaller than this limit.
workflow_bundle_too_large.summary: The workflow bundle file is larger than 128,000 bytes, so it was not read.

workflow_bundle_unavailable.fix: Pass the path of an existing regular bundle JSON file to `--bundle`. That path is resolved from the current directory, while pack paths inside the bundle are relative to `--repo`.
workflow_bundle_unavailable.summary: The `--bundle` path is missing or is not a regular file, such as a directory or named pipe, so it can't be read.

workflow_cancel_not_allowed.fix: Check `finassist workflow status --run-id` first. Reconcile running or unknown attempts with `workflow reconcile` before cancelling; completed or already cancelled runs need no cancellation.
workflow_cancel_not_allowed.summary: The run can't be cancelled because it is not pending or failed; it may be running, unknown, completed or already cancelled.

workflow_check_pack_invalid.fix: Give the checks pack `data` with only `requirements` and `steps`, each entry shaped as in a workflow template. The goal and top-level `methodology` list belong in the workflow pack.
workflow_check_pack_invalid.summary: A checks pack's `data` is not exactly a `requirements` array and a `steps` array in workflow template format.

workflow_cleanup_unresolved.fix: Independently verify that the attempt's processes and containers have stopped, then record a failure with `workflow reconcile --confirm-cleanup` instead of `--approve-artifact`. Use `workflow retry` if another attempt is warranted.
workflow_cleanup_unresolved.summary: The saved result for this attempt does not confirm process cleanup, so it can't be adopted as a completed check.

workflow_dependency_cycle.fix: Remove the circular `depends_on` link, including any step that depends on itself, so the steps form an acyclic graph.
workflow_dependency_cycle.summary: The workflow steps' dependencies form a cycle, so no valid execution order exists.

workflow_dependency_unknown.fix: List step IDs, not requirement IDs, in `depends_on`, and check their spelling. With packs, a checks pack may depend on steps defined in the workflow pack.
workflow_dependency_unknown.summary: A step's `depends_on` names a step `id` that does not exist in the workflow.

workflow_duplicate_recipe.fix: Give each requirement its own recipe. With packs, check `recipe_bindings` and policy `required_recipes` so that no two contract names map to the same configured recipe.
workflow_duplicate_recipe.summary: Two workflow obligations resolve to the same recipe, so one check record could not show which requirement it satisfies.

workflow_duplicate_requirement.fix: Give every entry in `requirements` a unique `id`, and update the matching step's `requirement` field.
workflow_duplicate_requirement.summary: Two workflow requirements use the same `id`, so steps and results can't be mapped to a single requirement.

workflow_duplicate_step.fix: Give every entry in `steps` a unique `id`, and update any `depends_on` lists that refer to it.
workflow_duplicate_step.summary: Two workflow steps use the same `id`, so dependencies and checkpoints would be ambiguous.

workflow_methodology_empty.fix: Commit the document's real content, then rebuild the packet with `finassist plan` and the plan with `finassist workflow plan`, or remove the document from the template if it doesn't apply.
workflow_methodology_empty.summary: A methodology document is empty or only whitespace at the packet's head commit, so it can't define validation rules.

workflow_methodology_missing.fix: Check the path and commit the document at the head you review; uncommitted edits don't count. Then rebuild the packet with `finassist plan` and rerun `finassist workflow plan`.
workflow_methodology_missing.summary: A methodology document named in the template does not exist in the packet's head commit, so it can't be bound to the plan.

workflow_methodology_not_text.fix: Save the document as UTF-8 text and commit it, or point the template at a text version, then rebuild the packet and the workflow plan.
workflow_methodology_not_text.summary: A methodology document is not valid UTF-8 text, so it can't be screened or bound to the plan.

workflow_methodology_outside_scope.fix: Keep methodology documents in reviewed source covered by `allow_paths` and not under `generated_paths`, then update the template. Widen `allow_paths` only after reviewing what else it would admit.
workflow_methodology_outside_scope.summary: A methodology document is outside the configured source allowlist or under a generated path, so it can't govern the workflow.

workflow_methodology_reference_invalid.fix: Add the path to the top-level `methodology` list, or correct the requirement's `methodology` entry so it matches a listed path exactly.
workflow_methodology_reference_invalid.summary: A requirement cites a methodology path that is not in the template's top-level `methodology` list.

workflow_methodology_unused.fix: Reference the document from at least one requirement's `methodology` list, or remove it from the top-level list.
workflow_methodology_unused.summary: A document in the template's top-level `methodology` list is not cited by any requirement, so its role is undefined.

workflow_outcome_audit_unavailable.fix: Don't start the step again. Run `finassist workflow status` for the run, check the step's effects, then use `finassist workflow reconcile` as the workflow execution guide describes.
workflow_outcome_audit_unavailable.summary: A workflow step's result couldn't be recorded, so whether it completed is unknown.

workflow_pack_digest_mismatch.fix: Don't just copy the new digest into the bundle. Review what changed in the pack; if the change is intended, update that reference's `sha256`, otherwise restore the reviewed file. Whitespace edits also need a new pin.
workflow_pack_digest_mismatch.summary: A pack file's SHA-256 digest does not match its pin in the bundle, so its bytes are not the reviewed version.

workflow_pack_duplicate_key.fix: Remove the duplicate key from the file. If it was a pack, review the result and update that pack's `sha256` pin in the bundle.
workflow_pack_duplicate_key.summary: A pack or bundle JSON file repeats a key within one object, so its meaning would depend on which value wins.

workflow_pack_duplicate_name.fix: Give each pack file a unique `name` and update its `sha256` pin, or remove the duplicate pack reference from the bundle.
workflow_pack_duplicate_name.summary: Two packs in the bundle declare the same `name`, so their provenance would be ambiguous.

workflow_pack_duplicate_path.fix: Keep one reference per pack file in the bundle's `packs` list.
workflow_pack_duplicate_path.summary: The bundle lists the same pack `path` more than once.

workflow_pack_invalid.fix: Give each pack exactly `schema_version` 1, `name`, a semantic `version` like 1.0.0, `kind` (profile, workflow, checks or policy), `compatibility` with integer 1 values, and an object `data`. Then update its pin.
workflow_pack_invalid.summary: A pack file is not valid UTF-8 JSON, uses NaN or Infinity, or does not match the version-1 pack schema.

workflow_pack_multiple_workflows.fix: Keep a single workflow pack. Move extra requirements and steps into a pack of kind checks.
workflow_pack_multiple_workflows.summary: The bundle includes more than one pack of kind workflow, but exactly one is allowed.

workflow_pack_path_invalid.fix: Reference each pack by its `.json` file path, relative to `--repo`.
workflow_pack_path_invalid.summary: A pack reference's `path` does not end in `.json`, so it was not loaded.

workflow_pack_unavailable_or_large.fix: Check that each `path` in the bundle names an existing regular file relative to `--repo`. Split a pack over 128,000 bytes, such as a long profile or checks pack, into several packs.
workflow_pack_unavailable_or_large.summary: A referenced pack file is missing, is not a regular file, or is larger than 128,000 bytes.

workflow_pack_workflow_required.fix: Add a reference to exactly one pack with `kind` workflow whose `data` is a complete version-1 workflow template.
workflow_pack_workflow_required.summary: The bundle has no pack of kind workflow, so there is no base template to resolve.

workflow_packet_mode_evidence_missing.fix: Rebuild the packet with the current `finassist plan` command, then rerun `finassist workflow plan` with the new packet.
workflow_packet_mode_evidence_missing.summary: The source packet uses schema version 1, which lacks the Git file-mode evidence that workflow plans require.

workflow_plan_approval_required.fix: Inspect the plan, then pass its exact full `plan_hash` to `--approve-plan`. For resume, retry and cancel, use the hash of the plan the run was created with, shown by `workflow status --run-id`.
workflow_plan_approval_required.summary: The `--approve-plan` value does not equal the plan's `plan_hash`, so execution or the state change was refused.

workflow_plan_bindings_invalid.fix: Don't edit or retry with this plan. Regenerate it with `finassist workflow plan` from the reviewed template and packet, and compare the new `plan_hash` before approving it.
workflow_plan_bindings_invalid.summary: The plan's methodology or recipe binding lists don't match its embedded template, so the plan can't be trusted.

workflow_plan_integrity_failed.fix: Don't edit or retry with this plan. Regenerate it with `finassist workflow plan` from the reviewed template and packet, and compare the new `plan_hash` before approving it.
workflow_plan_integrity_failed.summary: The plan's `template_hash` or `plan_hash` does not match its content, so the plan changed after it was created.

workflow_plan_invalid.fix: Check that `--plan` points to output of `finassist workflow plan`, not a template or packet. Don't hand-edit plans; regenerate one and compare its `plan_hash` before approving it.
workflow_plan_invalid.summary: The plan file does not match the version-1 workflow plan schema; it may have been edited or be a different kind of file.

workflow_plan_run_unfinished.fix: Find it with `finassist workflow status`, then resume, reconcile, retry or cancel that run instead of creating a duplicate.
workflow_plan_run_unfinished.summary: An unfinished run (pending, running, unknown or failed) already exists for this plan in the state directory.

workflow_policy_pack_invalid.fix: Use only integer caps from 1 to 2,000,000, USD cost caps of 0 or more, `allow_network`, `allow_partial_review` or `allow_local_readiness` set to false, and `required_recipes` or `blocking_severities` lists.
workflow_policy_pack_invalid.summary: A policy pack's `data` has an unknown key or a value of the wrong type or outside the allowed range.

workflow_preflight_blocked.fix: Run `finassist workflow preflight` with the same packet and plan to see `blocking_reasons`. Rebuild the packet and plan for the current head and configuration, review them, and approve the new `plan_hash`.
workflow_preflight_blocked.summary: Preflight found blocking reasons, such as a changed head, configuration, packet or recipe, so the run was not created.

workflow_profile_conflict.fix: Rename the pack's profile, or make its checklist identical to the existing definition in the base configuration or an earlier pack.
workflow_profile_conflict.summary: A profile pack redefines an existing profile name with a different checklist, so resolution refused to overwrite it.

workflow_profile_pack_invalid.fix: Shape `data` as profile names (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter) mapped to arrays of 1-64 unique strings of up to 2,000 characters each.
workflow_profile_pack_invalid.summary: A profile pack's `data` is not a map of 1-64 profile names to lists of non-empty checklist strings.

workflow_recipe_binding_unknown.fix: Map the contract in `recipe_bindings` to a recipe that exists in the base configuration, or add that recipe to the reviewed configuration. An unlisted contract must match a configured name exactly.
workflow_recipe_binding_unknown.summary: A pack recipe contract, or its binding target, is not a recipe defined in the base configuration's `recipes`.

workflow_recipe_binding_unused.fix: Remove the unused entry from `recipe_bindings`, or correct its key to the contract name used in the packs.
workflow_recipe_binding_unused.summary: A `recipe_bindings` entry names a contract that no requirement or policy `required_recipes` uses.

workflow_recipe_unconfigured.fix: Add the recipe to the reviewed configuration's `recipes` and pass it with `--config`, or change the requirement's `recipe` to a configured name. With packs, map it through `recipe_bindings`.
workflow_recipe_unconfigured.summary: A workflow requirement names a recipe that is not defined in the configuration's `recipes`.

workflow_reconciliation_choice_required.fix: Pass exactly one of `--approve-artifact` or `--confirm-cleanup`. The CLI already enforces this, so seeing it from the CLI indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
workflow_reconciliation_choice_required.summary: Reconciliation needs exactly one choice, adopting a saved result or confirming cleanup, not both or neither.

workflow_reconciliation_not_required.fix: Check `finassist workflow status --run-id` for the step's `state` and `attempt_id`. Only unknown or interrupted running attempts need reconciliation; use `workflow retry` for failed steps.
workflow_reconciliation_not_required.summary: The step is not in an uncertain state, or the attempt ID is not its latest attempt, so there is nothing to reconcile.

workflow_required_recipe_omitted.fix: Add a requirement and step that use each required recipe. With packs, policy `required_recipes` count too; add a checks pack that covers them.
workflow_required_recipe_omitted.summary: A recipe in `required_recipes` has no requirement in the workflow, so a mandatory check would be skipped.

workflow_resolution_destination_exists.fix: Choose a new directory path for `--output`. If an earlier resolve failed, inspect its partial files and don't treat them as a successful resolution.
workflow_resolution_destination_exists.summary: The `--output` directory for `workflow resolve` already exists, and resolution never writes into an existing one.

workflow_resolution_inputs_changed.fix: Pass the `config.json` (with `--config`) and `template.json` from the same resolve output, unchanged. If you changed them, rerun `finassist workflow resolve` into a new directory and review the result.
workflow_resolution_inputs_changed.summary: The resolution record does not match the current configuration or template, so it can't be linked to this plan.

workflow_resolution_invalid.fix: Don't edit `resolution.json` or retry with it. Rerun `finassist workflow resolve` into a new directory and compare the new hashes with the ones reported earlier.
workflow_resolution_invalid.summary: The resolution record does not match its schema, or its `resolution_hash` does not match its content.

workflow_resolution_limit_exceeded.fix: Reduce what the packs contribute, for example long profile checklists or many requirements and steps, then resolve again into a new directory.
workflow_resolution_limit_exceeded.summary: A resolved configuration, template or resolution record exceeds 2,000,000 bytes, more than later commands accept.

workflow_result_invalid.fix: Don't edit the saved result. Reconcile with the same configuration the plan was bound to; if it still fails, verify cleanup, record a failure with `--confirm-cleanup`, then use `workflow retry`.
workflow_result_invalid.summary: A check result doesn't match the recorded recipe, head, snapshot, image, output or configuration, so it can't be adopted.

workflow_retry_not_allowed.fix: Check `finassist workflow status --run-id` for the step's `state` and latest `attempt_id`. Reconcile unknown attempts first; only a failed step in a run that is not cancelled can be retried.
workflow_retry_not_allowed.summary: The step can't be retried: the run is cancelled, the step is not failed, or the attempt ID is not its latest.

workflow_run_busy.fix: Wait for the other command to finish, then retry. Don't delete files in `workflow-locks/` to get past this; the OS releases the lock when its process exits.
workflow_run_busy.summary: Another finassist command holds this workflow run's lock, so a second executor or state change was refused.

workflow_run_identifier_invalid.fix: Copy the exact `workflow_run_id` printed by `workflow run`, or list runs with `finassist workflow status` without `--run-id`.
workflow_run_identifier_invalid.summary: The run ID is not 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, so it can't name a workflow run.

workflow_run_unknown.fix: Use the same `--repo`, `--state-dir` or `--audit-dir` as when the run was created; the default state is `.finassist` in the repository. List runs with `finassist workflow status`.
workflow_run_unknown.summary: No workflow run with this ID exists in the selected state directory, or that directory has no audit database.

workflow_state_invalid.fix: Don't edit the audit database to clear this. If a newer finassist version wrote this state, use that version. Otherwise keep the state directory as evidence and open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
workflow_state_invalid.summary: The audit ledger has a malformed, unsupported or impossible workflow event, so the workflow state can't be trusted.

workflow_step_coverage_invalid.fix: Define exactly one step per requirement, and set each step's `requirement` to a different requirement `id`.
workflow_step_coverage_invalid.summary: The workflow steps don't map one-to-one onto the requirements, so some obligation would have no step or two steps.

workflow_step_outcome_unknown.fix: Don't start the step again. Run `finassist workflow status` for the run, check the step's effects, then use `finassist workflow reconcile` to adopt the result or confirm cleanup.
workflow_step_outcome_unknown.summary: A workflow step was interrupted after it started, so whether it completed is unknown.

workflow_template_invalid.fix: Use exactly `schema_version` 1, `name`, a non-blank `goal`, `methodology`, `requirements` and `steps`, with no extra fields; IDs start with a lowercase letter. Start from the template in the workflow plans guide.
workflow_template_invalid.summary: The workflow template doesn't match the version-1 template schema or its goal is blank, so it can't be planned.

workflow_timeline_page_invalid.fix: Use `--limit` from 1 to 1000 and an `--after` value from 0 up to the last sequence, normally `pagination.next_after` from the previous page.
workflow_timeline_page_invalid.summary: The timeline page is out of range: `--after` is negative or past the ledger end, or `--limit` is not 1-1000.

workflow_timeline_snapshot_changed.fix: Copy `--through` and `--anchor` exactly from an earlier report's `snapshot.through_sequence` and `snapshot.through_hash`. If they were exact, the ledger history changed since then; investigate instead of re-anchoring.
workflow_timeline_snapshot_changed.summary: The pinned timeline snapshot is unavailable: `--through` is past the ledger end or its event hash no longer equals `--anchor`.

workflow_timeline_snapshot_invalid.fix: Pass both or neither. `--through` must be at least 1 and not below `--after`, and `--anchor` must be the full 64-character lowercase hash from a report's `snapshot.through_hash`.
workflow_timeline_snapshot_invalid.summary: The `--through` and `--anchor` pair is incomplete or malformed, so no historical snapshot can be pinned.
